svg.title: Seven ways to grow a wallet
svg.desc: Seven charts show the median modeled wallet every five active minutes over 40 hours. The dashed line marks the $2 million current-cash property market gate. Purchases lower cash. Each point is the median across the runs. Delivery saver: 250/250 first homes, median 17.7 hours; First cab: 250/250 first homes, median 16.2 hours; Fleet reinvestor: 250/250 first homes, median 15.2 hours; Customizer: 250/250 first homes, median 17 hours; Delivery explorer: 250/250 first homes, median 17.7 hours; 30-minute casual: 250/250 first homes, median 21.7 hours; Mixed economy: 250/250 first homes, median 18.4 hours.

g.text: Seven ways to grow a wallet
Median wallet · 250 simulated players per path · event bonuses off
Dashed line = $2m cash gate. Buying a home or upgrades lowers the wallet.
Each point is the median across runs.
